title: Prune or branch

blocks.text: A warehouse-siting search (open a site or not, 0-1 variables, maximize the yearly saving) has just solved one node's LP. The loop needs to know what to do with the node.
Write `classify(status, bound, integral, incumbent, whole_values=False)` in `classify.py`.

items: `bound` is the node's LP value (ignore it when the LP is infeasible);
`integral` says whether the LP solution is all 0 and 1;
`incumbent` is the best plan's value so far, or `None` before the first plan;
`whole_values` says that every plan is worth a whole number.

blocks.text: Return one of `"infeasible"`, `"bound"`, `"incumbent"` or `"branch"`, with the tests in this order:
where $`\underline{z}`$ is `incumbent`; with no incumbent, the bound test never prunes.

Round down with a small guard, as the lesson's `can_beat` does with `math.floor(bound + EPS)`: an LP value a solver returns as 101.9999999999 for a true 102 must count as 102, not 101. The reference solution uses `math.floor(bound + 1e-9)`; the lesson's `EPS` of `1e-6` passes the tests too. With `whole_values` false, the reference compares `bound` unrounded and with no guard.

cases.says: a node whose LP has no solution is pruned as infeasible
a fractional node whose bound is above the incumbent is branched
an integral node worth more than the incumbent becomes the new incumbent
before the first plan, every feasible node is branched or becomes the incumbent
a bound equal to the incumbent is pruned, since a tie is no improvement
an integral node worth less than the incumbent is pruned by bound and never replaces it
with whole values, a bound of 100.6 against an incumbent of 100 is pruned
an LP value a hair below a whole number rounds down to that whole number, not the one below

origin.section: With Whole-Number Values, Round the Bound Down Before Comparing

concepts: the incumbent is the best real plan so far, and its value is a lower bound on the optimum
a node's LP value bounds every plan below it, and it never rises going down the tree
with whole-number plan values, a node's bound is rounded down before the comparison
a node is pruned when it is infeasible, cannot beat the incumbent, or is integral, tested in that order
